surprises.title: Walls weep water
surprises.description: After a rainstorm, the foundation wall is damp, and there's a puddle in the corner.

options.text: Hang drywall over it
Dig out and waterproof every wall
Fix gutters and grading, then waterproof

surprises.title: Foundation crack appears
surprises.description: Behind the old paneling: a crack running from floor to ceiling.

options.text: Fill it with spray foam
Have a structural engineer evaluate it
Replace the foundation

surprises.title: Ceiling is too low
surprises.description: A duct and a drain hang so low you'll hit your head. Every time.

options.text: Lower the basement floor
Box them into a soffit
Just duck

surprises.title: Egress window is missing
surprises.description: The inspector asks where the egress window is for the new bedroom. There isn't one.

options.text: Add egress windows to every room
Cut in an egress window and well
Call it an office instead

surprises.title: Sump pump dies
surprises.description: The sump pump clicks, hums, and does nothing. It's rained all week.

options.text: Install a full perimeter drain system
Bail the pit with a bucket
Replace the pump and add a backup

surprises.title: Radon tests high
surprises.description: The radon test comes back well above the action level.

options.text: Install a radon mitigation system
Seal off the basement forever
Open a window now and then

surprises.title: Panel runs out of room
surprises.description: The new circuits need space, and the panel is completely full.

options.text: Upgrade the utility service
Double-tap the breakers
Add a subpanel

surprises.title: Extension cords appear
surprises.description: Behind the old paneling: a tangle of extension cords stapled to the wall.

options.text: Hide them behind the drywall
Rewire the whole house
Replace them with proper wiring in boxes

surprises.title: Floor drain backs up
surprises.description: During a storm, the floor drain gurgles and burps up something unpleasant.

options.text: Install a backwater valve
Put a heavy box over the drain
Replace the main sewer line

surprises.title: Stairs fail code
surprises.description: The stairs are steep, and the headroom is low. The inspector is not smiling.

options.text: Rebuild the stairs to code
Move the staircase
Add a handrail and hope

surprises.title: Joists grow mold
surprises.description: Your flashlight finds white fuzz on the floor joists above.

options.text: Replace the joists
Dry, clean, and add a dehumidifier
Paint it white so it blends in

surprises.title: Basement stays cold
surprises.description: The new space has one tiny vent. It's a refrigerator down here.

options.text: Replace the whole HVAC system
Add supply and return ducts
Plug in a space heater forever

surprises.title: Post blocks the layout
surprises.description: A steel column sits right where the TV wall should go.

options.text: Cut the post out
Add a long-span beam to remove the post
Design the layout around the post

surprises.title: Drain runs uphill
surprises.description: The new basement bathroom sits below the sewer line. Water does not flow uphill.

options.text: Install an ejector pit
Dig a deeper sewer line to the street
Hope gravity changes its mind

surprises.title: Permit is missing
surprises.description: Your neighbor asks if you pulled a permit. You... did not.

options.text: Close the curtains and keep working
Hire an architect for full plans
Apply for a permit now

surprises.title: Old oil tank appears
surprises.description: Behind the boxes in the corner: a rusty old heating oil tank.

options.text: Paint it and use it as a side table
Have it professionally removed
Dig up the yard looking for more tanks

surprises.title: Home theater dream
surprises.description: It's a basement. It's dark. It's perfect for a home theater.

options.text: Stack three TVs on the floor
Run the wiring now, buy gear later
Install a full projector system this month

surprises.title: Wet bar beckons
surprises.description: What's a basement without a wet bar? Lonely, that's what.

options.text: Put a cooler on a bookshelf
Build a full bar with a kegerator now
Rough in a drain for the future

surprises.title: Partner wants a gym
surprises.description: Your partner: "We could put the gym down here. With the heavy weights."

options.text: Lay rubber flooring on the slab
Bolt a pull-up bar to a single joist
Build a climbing wall

surprises.title: Storage boxes multiply
surprises.description: To finish the basement, all the boxes have to move. There are... so many boxes.

options.text: Stack them in the garage. Bye, car
Rent a storage unit forever
Sort and donate as you go

video.title: Finish a basement on a budget

ask.question: How do I finish my basement?
ask.answer: Exciting! 1. Put up walls. 2. Paint them. 3. Add a couch!
ask.skipped: It skipped moisture, permits, wiring and insulation.
